description: A PHP class defining a form for managing impact data in an admin interface, including form creation, validation, and saving logic.

classes.name: AdminImpactDataForm
classes.description: A form processor class for creating, validating, and saving impact data in the admin panel.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Initializes the form with fields for impact data, including title, description, data, image, type, source, result message, operation type, and submit button.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the form data into the ImpactData model, handling image uploads and errors.

methods.name: getImpactDataTypes
methods.description: Retrieves impact data types with localized labels.

methods.name: getImpactSources
methods.description: Retrieves impact data sources with localized labels.

methods.name: getImpactOperations
methods.description: Retrieves impact data operations with localized labels.
